title: Buffalo Dip
ingredients: 2 can chickpeas, mash half of them with fork
garlic & onion powder, salt, and pepper
2 c. shredded cheese; half mixed in, half for garnish
methods: Mix all non garnish items together

title: Slow Cooker Chili
ingredients: chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper
adjust to desired consistency with veggie stock, ~2 c.
methods: Cook in slow cooker on high for 4-5h or on low for 6-7h
